2607.19063.title: Quality Action Assurance: Multimodal Verification of Examiner Claims in VR OSCEs
2607.19063.paper_summary: Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) are the gold standard for assessing clinical competence, yet scoring remains vulnerable to examiner subjectivity, fatigue, and cognitive bias. Standard examiner validation via inter-rater statistics lacks explanatory power regarding the source of errors, as it neither analyzes examiner reasoning nor verifies examiner claims against actual events. Thus, we introduce Quality Action Assurance (QAA), a multimodal framework that verifies examiner claims in Virtual Reality (VR) pediatric OSCEs by comparing actions claimed by examiners against the true sequence of events, constructed from video, VR logs, and actor data. QAA combines a constrained temporal action alignment model, which performs action localization and actor source attribution, with a large language model that extracts examiner claims and checks them against the record. Across a 5-fold cross-validation, QAA achieves 99.2% $\pm$ 0.7% Actor F1 and 93.4% $\pm$ 1.9% W@16 for temporal alignment. Overall, QAA detects examiner errors with 69.9% precision and 76.7% recall, improving factual correctness from 39.2% to 79.2%, enabling fairer OSCE assessment.
2607.19063.paper_summary_zh: 目標結構化臨床考試 (OSCEs) 是評估臨床能力的金標準，但評分仍然容易受到考官主觀性、疲勞和認知偏見的影響。標準的考官驗證通過評估者之間的統計數據缺乏解釋力，因為它既不分析考官的推理，也不將考官的主張與實際事件進行驗證。因此，我們引入了質量行動保證 (QAA)，這是一個多模態框架，通過將考官聲稱的行動與從視頻、VR 日誌和演員數據構建的真實事件序列進行比較，來驗證考官在虛擬現實 (VR) 兒科 OSCE 中的主張。QAA 結合了一個受限的時間行動對齊模型，該模型執行行動定位和演員來源歸屬，與一個大型語言模型，該模型提取考官的主張並將其與記錄進行檢查。在 5 倍交叉驗證中，QAA 實現了 99.2% $\pm$ 0.7% 演員 F1 和 93.4% $\pm$ 1.9% W@16 的時間對齊。總體而言，QAA 以 69.9% 的精確度和 76.7% 的召回率檢測考官錯誤，將事實正確性從 39.2% 提高到 79.2%，使 OSCE 評估更加公平。
